name: Deep Dark Web
source:
One fine day, an ordinary student named Taras falls into a whirlwind of events. The boy meets a strange person on the dark side of the Internet, and she invites him to see a different world, free from rules and obligations. How will this story end? Download the game and find out.

[Translated from [url=https://elhatar.itch.io/deep-dark-web]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个晴朗的日子，一位名叫塔拉斯的普通学生陷入了一场旋风般的事件之中。男孩在互联网的黑暗面遇到了一个陌生的人，她邀请他去看一个不一样的世界，没有规则和义务。这个故事将如何结束？下载游戏并找出答案。

[译自[url=https://elhatar.itch.io/deep-dark-web]itch.io[/url]]
